name: Shadow Mastiff, Elite — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Shadow Mastiff, Elite from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Shadow Mastiff, Unseelie (3pp)" but are not part of the Shadow Mastiff, Elite entry, which is unchanged.

Unseelie Pact (Su)

An unseelie creature that becomes neutral or good loses the unseelie template, but it retains the evil subtype and vulnerability to silver weapons. If it becomes a good-aligned creature, it gains the seelie template.

Unseelie Sight (Su)

An unseelie creature using its invisibility ability can see other unseelie creatures using the same ability. In addition, it automatically succeeds on saves against illusion spells and eﬀects produced by unseelie creatures and immediately recognizes such eﬀects as illusions.

ECOLOGY

Environment Plane of Shadow
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (5-12)
Treasure none

Unseelie shadow mastiﬀs travel invisibly and silently through the world, tracking and ambushing unwary seelie creatures and creatures who defend with the green woods and ﬁelds that the seelie call home. Even when they are not invisible, their forms blend into shadow. An unseelie shadow mastiﬀ is a sleek, powerful, black-furred hound with a hellish-looking mastiﬀ’s head. Its powerful jaws are studded with unnaturally long teeth.

Unseelie shadow mastiﬀs use their shadow blend and invisibility together with their natural cunning to remain unobserved, but they are less apt to use their other spell-like abilities. Some have learned to use silent image and ghost sound to distract foes or fool them as to their whereabouts.

Unseelie shadow mastiﬀs speak broken Sylvan, but with their mean intelligence, they rarely communicate.
